question: What happens if some cause is designated as an external original image?
premises: One might designate some cause as an external original image.
Anything appearing in consciousness takes on the nature of a reflection.
Outside of consciousness, such a cause would be unreal.
inference: Therefore even a supposed external cause becomes a reflection in consciousness or is unreal.
plain_english: Even if some cause is designated as an external original image, it too becomes a reflection in consciousness; otherwise, outside of consciousness, it would be unreal.
